name: Of Red and Waveless Sea
source:
Bonds of sisterhood, a thirst for vengeance, and the crimson walls of the Imperial City... Scarlet fills her vision, but what is it: the blood of the fallen, or the cage she is stepping into? 
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Of_Red_and_Waveless_Sea]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
姐妹情深、复仇渴求，以及皇城那一道道朱红宫墙……绯红填满了她的视野——可那究竟是逝者的鲜血，还是她正一步步踏入的囚笼？
[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Of_Red_and_Waveless_Sea]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
